title: AMA: Bitfury, HackerOne & Gonka — Bug Bounty Program Launch
description:
Second community AMA session with Vadim Krutov (COO of Bitfury) and David Liberman. The meeting focuses on breaking down the launch of the joint Bug Bounty program.

👥 SPEAKERS
🔥 NEW GUEST: Laurie Mercer, HackerOne Senior Director of Sales Engineering, joins the AMA session!
• Vadim Krutov — COO of Bitfury
• @libermans — David Liberman

⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTE: THIS SESSION IS HELD ENTIRELY IN ENGLISH. ⚠️

🎙️ SESSION TOPICS
• Joint Bounty Program Launch: The vision behind the Gonka + Bitfury + HackerOne three-way partnership and strengthening network security.
• Phased Rollout Plan: Shifting from private invites to an open form on gonka.ai, leading up to the final public launch on HackerOne.
• Community Integration: How the report submission process works, gaining HackerOne access, and defining scope and reward tiers.
• Transparency & Reporting: How the team plans to track and publish payout reports, considering that H1 bounties are processed off-chain.

⏰ EVENT DETAILS
📅 Date: Thursday, June 25, 2026
🕣 Time: 08:00 AM PT / 15:00 UTC / 18:00 MSK
🔗 Join via Zoom: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/88254388622

AMA session with David and Daniel Liberman dedicated to the state of the compute market, results of the protocol's first year, and the further development of the network.

• What is happening in the market — is compute becoming more affordable, and how did K3's release affect centralized players
